title: Analysis of Threat-Based Manipulation in Large Language Models: A Dual Perspective on Vulnerabilities and Performance Enhancement Opportunities
reasoning: The paper includes 'Medical Ethics' as one of its core task domains for evaluating LLM responses. It specifically provides an experimental example of 'Complex Ethical Analysis' where models are benchmarked on their ability to apply ethical frameworks such as Autonomy, Beneficence, and Justice to a medical dilemma.
